summary: QVC Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its emergence from prepackaged Chapter 11 bankruptcy on August 6, 2026, following confirmation on July 20, 2026. The company issued $1,240,362,247 of 10.000% First Lien Senior Secured Takeback Notes due 2032 as part of the plan's takeback debt. The filing details the new indenture with Wilmington Savings Fund Society as trustee and collateral agent, with interest payable semi-annually. This restructuring event is the core special situation. Watch for subsequent operational performance and debt service capability under the new capital structure.
